# Trazo (트라소)

> Trazo is a running and cycling route planner for South Korea (https://trazo.runvia.app). Users draw routes on a map, check distance/elevation/gradient, export GPX·FIT·TCX, and share routes with the community. Trazo provides a remote MCP server so AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude can read a user's routes and public community routes.

## AI integration (MCP)

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 sign-in, read-only): https://trazo.runvia.app/mcp
- Tools: `search_courses` (filter by sport, distance, elevation gain, loop/out-and-back, or radius around coordinates), `get_course` (elevation, gradient distribution, climbs, per-km splits, waypoints, areas passed), `find_place` (Korean place name → coordinates)
- Overview (Korean): https://trazo.runvia.app/ai/
- Overview (English): https://trazo.runvia.app/en/ai/
- Connect and manage connections: https://trazo.runvia.app/connect

## Pages

- Route planner (create a route): https://trazo.runvia.app/
- Course map — public running/cycling routes and public athletics tracks across Korea on one map (filters: all / cycling / running / tracks): https://trazo.runvia.app/explore
- Public course pages — https://trazo.runvia.app/c/<token>: location (city/district/neighborhoods), places passed, distance, elevation profile, difficulty, AI course description; GPX download without sign-in at https://trazo.runvia.app/c/<token>.gpx. All public course pages are listed in https://trazo.runvia.app/sitemap.xml
- Community — public routes sorted by newest, most saved, most liked, distance (long/short), elevation gain (high/low): https://trazo.runvia.app/community
- Running pace calculator — pace, finish time and distance for 5K/10K/half/full marathon, per-km splits, 400 m track lap times, Riegel race-time predictions: https://trazo.runvia.app/utility
- Cycling utilities (coming soon): https://trazo.runvia.app/utility/bike
- AI connection center (ChatGPT/Claude): https://trazo.runvia.app/connect
